title: Machine control labels
statement: The control-label set consists of an initialization label; syntax-checking labels parameterized by automaton states and input bits; node, push, return, quantifier, leaf, matrix, clause, and literal-processing labels with the Boolean parameters indicated by their roles; and copy, doubling, move, subtraction, and halving loop labels. The copy labels carry a copy-loop site and a phase in $\{0,\ldots,6\}$; doubling labels carry a Boolean and a phase in $\{0,\ldots,3\}$; move, subtraction, and halving labels each carry a Boolean and a phase in $\{0,1,2\}$.
caveat: The automaton-state type SynSt is not defined in the supplied snippet, so its syntax-checking labels cannot be described further.
